site.title: Embedded Screen Sharing Flasher
site.subtitle: Flash a browser-to-display video streamer straight from your browser - no PlatformIO needed

webH264.name: WebH264 Stream Display
webH264.description: Streams a browser tab or window to the AMOLED display over WiFi as H.264, encoded in-browser with WebCodecs and decoded on-device. Sharper image and much lower bandwidth than WebJPEG at the same quality, at the cost of a slower decoder (roughly 3-5fps). Auto-detects the attached panel at boot, so this one firmware works on the 1.47" Lite, 1.91", and 2.41"/T4-S3 T-Display AMOLED boards. Built 2026-08-04.
expectedBehavior: Device connects to WiFi and shows its IP address and mDNS hostname on screen
Open the streaming page linked above and share a browser tab or window
Live serial output below shows connection status and per-frame timing in real time

webJPEG.name: WebJPEG Stream Display
webJPEG.description: Streams a browser tab, camera, or screen share to the AMOLED display over WiFi as MJPEG frames. Auto-detects the attached panel at boot, so this one firmware works on the 1.47" Lite, 1.91", and 2.41"/T4-S3 T-Display AMOLED boards. Built 2026-08-04.
expectedBehavior: Device connects to WiFi and shows its IP address and mDNS hostname on screen
Open the streaming page linked above and share a browser tab, camera, or your whole screen
Live serial output below shows connection status and per-frame timing in real time

webJPEG-CYD.name: WebJPEG Stream Display (CYD)
webJPEG-CYD.description: Streams a browser tab, camera, or screen share to the display over WiFi as MJPEG frames - same protocol as WebJPEG, ported to the "Cheap Yellow Display" (ESP32-2432S028R): a much cheaper, widely available board with a 2.8" 240x320 LCD, completely outside the LilyGo AMOLED lineup the other firmwares here target. Built 2026-08-04.
expectedBehavior: Device connects to WiFi and shows its IP address and mDNS hostname on screen
Open the streaming page linked above and share a browser tab, camera, or your whole screen
Live serial output below shows connection status and per-frame timing in real time

webRAW.name: WebRAW Stream Display
webRAW.description: Streams a browser tab, window, or screen share to the AMOLED display over WiFi as raw RGB565 pixels, deflate-compressed in the browser - no JPEG anywhere in the pipeline, so it's lossless (no compression artifacts) while still keeping up a real-time frame rate (~7.75fps sustained on the 1.91" board with flow control on, close to WebH264's ~8.2fps). Auto-detects the attached panel at boot, so this one firmware works on the 1.47" Lite, 1.91", and 2.41"/T4-S3 T-Display AMOLED boards. Screen share only (no webcam). Built 2026-08-04.
expectedBehavior: Device connects to WiFi and shows its IP address and mDNS hostname on screen
Open the streaming page linked above and share a browser tab, window, or your whole screen
Live serial output below shows connection status and per-frame timing in real time

webRAW-CYD.name: WebRAW Stream Display (CYD)
webRAW-CYD.description: Streams a browser tab, window, or screen share to the same CYD board as WebJPEG-CYD, as raw RGB565 pixels deflate-compressed in the browser instead of JPEG - lossless, and roughly 3-6x faster to render than JPEG on this hardware (see that example's README), at the cost of a bigger payload unless the content compresses well. Screen share only (no webcam). Built 2026-08-04.
